messages:
vik: quickstart in gitpod spits real-looking emails into logs at debug level when you follow the onboarding guide. affects workspace demos. anyone working on sampleapp telemetry?
talia: ah that's new. gitpod uses the cloud workspace so logs stream to Stackdriver; if PII leaks there it's messy. can you paste a snippet?
vik: sure: ```2026-01-18T17:02:11.334Z DEBUG app request_id=rd-77 user.email=devtester@companymail.com route=/signup```
omar: sounds like the same autoinit ordering issue where instrumentation captures structured attrs before express redactor. but interesting twist: gitpod's live log tailing binds envs differently so LOG_LEVEL=debug is common in that flow.
talia: repro steps i used in gitpod: fork sampleapp -> open .devcontainer -> set LOG_LEVEL=debug -> run npm run dev -> trigger /signup. logs show full seed payloads.
michael: quick mitigation options: 1) change quickstart templates to set LOG_LEVEL=info 2) change seed user emails to example.invalid 3) add a pre-start scrub script for cloud workspaces 4) optionally disable SDK autoinit in quickstarts via AUTOINIT=false env var and document how to enable instrumentation manually.
vik: i can send a tiny PR for 1+2 today.
omar: for a better DX, SDK could offer a built-in pre-export LogProcessor that redacts common PII patterns when AUTOINIT=true. then sampleapps are safe out of the box. also add AUTOINIT_DELAY to let app middlewares mount first.
talia: +1 on both. but short term we should gate gitpod demos in CI: if onboarding smoke logs contain /@/ or domain patterns, fail the job. ci-bot do we have a quick grep job?
ci-bot: you can add a step: ```- name: onboarding-log-scan run: grep -E "[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}" logs/*.log && echo "PII found" && exit 1 || true``` recommend running after container start and tests.
michael: small note: fluentd/stackdriver transformations can mangle fields; we should canonicalize the request id key across the stack (x-rd-request-id -> rd.request_id). add a doc snippet for proxy/nginx and fluentd mappings.
omar: also watch for duplicate ids: access proxy may set `x-request-id` and SDK generates `rd.request_id` from trace context. normalize at ingress.
talia: created ticket INF-1012: "quickstart/gitpod: PII in logs + onboarding telemetry ordering" https://tracker.internal/INF-1012 :bug:
vik: i'll take the PR to update quickstart defaults (LOG_LEVEL=info, seeds -> example.invalid) and add the small gitpod scrub script. assigning to myself.
michael: i'll draft the SDK AUTOINIT redaction proposal and an AUTOINIT_DELAY env opt RFC.
omar: i'll add the CI grep step to the onboarding workflow and a short docs note about canonical request id mapping.
telemetry-bot: Added INF-1012 to telemetry board and set priority=medium.
talia: thanks team. small fixes unblock demos and keep PII out of cloud-workspace logs. :white_check_mark:
